tmp:2454: ra gamur — 'complete evil': the status of the seventy nations' languages as unmixed, total evil (unlike Nogah, which contains good to extract)
tmp:2455: machaloket as verbal abuse — conflict defined as people reproaching/insulting a person, which brings on spiritual hunger and is the aspect of the foreskin (orlah)
tmp:2457: ra'avin — Aramaic 'wills' (as in ra'ava d'ra'avin, the Will of wills of Atika); here Malkhut is identified as the aspect of 'wills'
tmp:2459: the act of giving honor to an elder who has forgotten his Torah learning (Berakhot 8b) — the deed that generates spiritual thunder, which brings cold reviving waters
tmp:2461: mi-sitra d'Yitzchak — 'from the side of Isaac': kabbalistic attribution of the gevurot (severities/thunders) to Isaac's left-side sefirotic lineage
tmp:2462: hir'im — the verb 'He thundered' in Scripture, expounded (per Zohar) as the aspect of the supernal thunders (re'amim) born of gevurot
tmp:2467: other people's wills that oppose one's own will — the inner definition of machaloket (conflict), annulled by fasting per 'nullify your will before His will' (Avot 2)
tmp:2468: he'arat ha-raglayim — the illumination/light of the feet, revealed through dancing (rikkudin), paired with the illumination of the hands in clapping
tmp:2469: 'Adonai sefatai tiftach' (Psalms 51:17) — the verse opening the Amidah, 'O Lord, open my lips,' expounded as the aspect of wedding dancing
tmp:2470: rikkudin shel chatunah — wedding dancing as a mystical act drawing the alephs/light of the heart down through the feet to the bride (Malkhut), sweetening her 320 judgments
tmp:2471: reshimah — an engraved mark/inscription, like the letter tav inscribed on foreheads ('ve-hitvita tav,' Ezekiel 9:4); the trace-imprint sense of the root
tmp:2472: rasha ve-ra lo — 'a wicked man who fares badly' (Berakhot 7a theodicy category): here the wicked person attached to the tzaddik whose halakhic opinion is NOT followed
tmp:2473: the wicked person who is drawn close to the tzaddik whose halakhic ruling is not accepted — the referent of 'rasha ve-ra lo' in the theodicy scheme
tmp:2474: rasha ve-tov lo — 'a wicked man who prospers' (Berakhot 7a theodicy category): here the wicked person attached to the tzaddik whose halakhic opinion IS followed
tmp:2475: the wicked person who is drawn close to the tzaddik whose halakhic ruling is accepted — the referent of 'rasha ve-tov lo' in the theodicy scheme
tmp:2476: five times din — gematria device: din (64) × 5 = 320 (ShaKh), the harsh judgments of the bride/na'ar before the heh is drawn to her making five times 'Adonai'
tmp:2477: tamar of the Sitra Achra — the demonic counterpart date-palm (temurah, 'exchange'), embodiment of the totality of harsh judgments opposing 'the tzaddik flourishes like a tamar'
tmp:2478: se'or ke-kotevet — 'leaven the size of a date' (halakhic Yom Kippur measure, Berakhot/Yoma): leaven = concentrated judgments, the kotevet-date marking the Other Side's tamar
tmp:2479: the phenomenon that one disciple is closer to the Rebbe than another — explained as due solely to his greater holy boldness (azut di-kedushah) to speak with him
tmp:2480: the person who senses a slight impurity confusing him — one just outside/behind holiness (after the twelve tribes), disturbed by minor tumah, in the Rabbah bar bar Chanah tale
tmp:2483: she'elot u-teshuvot — 'questions and answers' (responsa): the book generated from every dispute, punning teshuvah-answer with teshuvah-repentance
tmp:2484: the attainment of the tachlit — meriting to reach the ultimate purpose/end, for whose sake the soul must ultimately leave the speech and 'glean in another field'
tmp:2485: shevilei ha-Torah — the hidden pathways of Torah containing very great contemplation, attainable only through great wealth ('if there is no flour, there is no Torah')
tmp:2487: shevirat ha-luchot — Moses' breaking of the Tablets, identified with the broken heart via 'write them on the tablet of your heart' (Proverbs 3)
tmp:2489: ruach nedivah — 'a generous/willing spirit' (Psalms 51:14): tzedakah as the cooling spirit that descends to quench the heart's burning craving for money
tmp:2490: sheva gildei eina — the seven membranes/layers of the eye (Tikkunei Zohar), corresponding to Samson's seven locks and the seven middot of the mochin
tmp:2491: sheva middot — the seven emotive attributes (lower sefirot) that pass fleetingly (cholfin) through the thought of the brain, matching the seven locks/eye-layers
tmp:2492: shiv'ah gildei eina — the Tikkunei Zohar doctrine of the eye's seven layers (Intro 12, Tikkun 70), basis for the eyes being 'hairs'/seven machlefot of the head
tmp:2493: shiv'im lashon — the seventy languages of the nations, identified with the storm wind/spirit of folly that rises via Targum-sleep to suckle from the Holy Tongue
tmp:2494: shiv'im panim la-Torah — the seventy 'faces' (modes of interpretation) of the Torah, each distinct, clothed in stories to awaken the sleeper
tmp:2495: shiv'im shanim — the seventy years (of a human lifespan), each different from the next, corresponding to the seventy faces of the Torah
tmp:2496: shiv'ah ananim — the seven Clouds of Glory that form the sukkah, identified with the seven lamps (of the menorah) through which one attains divine influx
tmp:2497: shiv'at yemei ha-mishteh — the seven days of wedding feasting after the chuppah, corresponding to the seven lamps/attainments of the surrounding light
tmp:2498: shivrei luchot — the fragments of the broken first Tablets, the root of forgetfulness ('had the first Tablets not been broken, Torah would not be forgotten,' Eruvin 54)
tmp:2499: b'nes — 'by miracle/sign': expounded as Shabbat, the eternal sign ('ot hi le-olam,' Exodus 31:17), the miraculous supra-natural order
tmp:2500: the joy and delight of the World to Come — the future bliss identified with Shabbat ('a taste of the World to Come')
tmp:2501: tefillah bi-dvekut — prayer said in devoted attachment to God, when the words flow willingly, elevating all previously scattered prayers
tmp:2502: 'shegurah tefillati be-fi' — R. Chanina ben Dosa's dictum (Berakhot 34b) 'my prayer is fluent in my mouth,' the sign of accepted prayer/devekut
tmp:2503: the state in which God Himself prays — one's prayer becoming God's own prayer ('that He, blessed be He, will pray'), attained through Torah study
tmp:2505: the protective function of yirah guarding against poverty — fear of God as the treasure-house (otzar) that preserves wealth from its opposite, want
